about: The shipped tuning defaults for every app: desktop (Electron) and the Apple apps (mac, ios for iPhone and iPad, tvos).

A value is either one value for every platform, or an object of per-platform values keyed by desktop, mac, ios, tvos, apple (mac, ios and tvos) and all. The most specific key wins: ios over apple over all. A platform with no matching key does not have that setting.
An optional note in a per-platform object says why a value is what it is.

Change it with npm run tuning: show, set, bake (paste a tuning copied from an app), combine (one value for every platform again). After editing by hand, run npm run tuning -- sync, which rewrites the Swift copy (apple/CascadeKit/Sources/CascadeKit/TuningDefaultsData.swift). npm test fails while that copy is stale.

style: the knobs people can change themselves (desktop Theme panel > Lyrics, Apple Style Tuning). A new default only reaches people who set that knob themselves through revisions, which npm run tuning keeps for you.
albumColors: the cover-color background (src/core/album-colors.ts, AlbumColors.swift). motion: the desktop's lyric scroll spring. Both are live on the desktop's debug tuning panel (.cascade-debug).

lyricsDelay.note: Negative is earlier: a line takes its fade to light up, so one that starts on the beat reads as late. The iPhone leads further, by Jon's tuning on one (2026-10-22).

lyricSize.note: Points. The desktop sizes lyrics by its own Text size setting (npTuning.lyricScale) instead.

currentLinePosition.note: Share of the lyrics area's height from its top. The Apple apps keep the line high, as Apple Music does; the desktop centers it.

bgBlur.note: The desktop paints its blobs as CSS gradients on the overlay itself, which has no blur short of blurring everything in front.

lyricsDimBase.note: The desktop already tints its panels for readability (styles/theme.css), so it starts with no extra dim.

controlsWokenIdleSeconds.note: Touch and remote only: how long controls a tap brought back stay up.

lyricSpringStiffness.note: Overdamped (critical damping for 250 is about 31.6), so lines ease in and never overshoot. Tuned by eye against Apple Music, 2026-09-23. The Apple apps use a 0.6 s SwiftUI spring.
